title: Store engine switch
lede: Which promotion engine each store runs. A store with no setting runs bonus buys. A flip takes effect at the store's next shift open, and a sale keeps the engine it was started with.
newPos: Only effective on NewPos stores. A NewPos rollback resets the store to bonus buys.

filter.search: Search a store by code or name

results.failed: Could not load the stores' engines.
results.denied: The store list is the campaign builder's stores lookup, and you do not hold its grant (RuleAuthoring).
results.capped: HQ answers at most <n>{{n}}</n> stores to a search: narrow it if a store is missing.

flip.shiftOpen: The flip takes effect at the store's next shift open, never during a shift. A sale already started keeps its engine.
flip.reasonRequired: Enter a reason for the flip.
flip.refusedTitle: HQ did not flip the store
flip.inFlightAfter: If anything is still in flight at the store, HQ lists it after the flip. It never blocks the flip.
flip.denied: You do not hold the grant to flip a store's engine (RuleEngineSwitch, change).

flipped.shiftOpen: From the store's next shift open.

already.Rule: {{store}} was already on the rule engine

inFlight.lede_one: The store is back on bonus buys from its next shift open. <n>{{n}}</n> thing is still in flight there. This is a warning only: nothing was blocked.
inFlight.lede_other: The store is back on bonus buys from its next shift open. <n>{{n}}</n> things are still in flight there. This is a warning only: nothing was blocked.
inFlight.truncated: HQ lists at most 100 of each kind; some were left out.
inFlight.liveCampaigns: Live campaigns: they stop reaching the store's tills
inFlight.openSessions: Customer sessions still paying: they keep the rule engine and still close
inFlight.storeBudgets: Store-scope budgets: their counters are kept

history.title: History
history.empty: This store has never been flipped.
history.failed: Could not load the store's history.
history.denied: You do not hold the grant to read a store's engine history (RuleEngineSwitch, display).
history.neverSet: HQ holds no setting for this store, so it runs bonus buys.
history.inFlightTruncated: (HQ kept at most 100 of each kind.)
